about: Test tasks one character can check by itself on the dev server (#5197). The steps up to the world are dev-release.json's; after them each step carries its test task's issue, and a failing step fails only its own task. The mining task (#4549) goes to the Iron-Breaker Mine and leaves the character there. The tidy steps at the end throw away the scratch journals the journal tasks made. Run it with Run-RealClient.ps1 -Steps tests\real-client\test-tasks.json.
